generation.prompt:
Generate a 4x4 grid of 16 flat-design icons on transparent background (PNG). Icons are numbered top-left to bottom-right, left-to-right, row by row:

1. Cloud (internet symbol), soft puffs, flat design, muted gray-blue color (#94A3B8)
2. Firewall/barrier icon, vertical orientation, brick pattern OR diagonal-line texture, rose/red color (#F43F5E) on a dark maroon fill (#4C0519)
3. Firewall strict variant, vertical, hazard cross-hatching or double-barrier pattern (visually denser than #2), same rose/red color (#F43F5E)
4. Surprised emoji-like face (dot eyes, open O-mouth), amber/gold color (#FBBF24)
5. Happy emoji-like face (dot eyes, smile curve), mint color (#2CD1A8)
6. House with roof, minimalist front view (small door/window optional), rose/red color (#F43F5E)
7. Office/apartment building, tall, front view, 3x3 window grid clearly visible, rose/red color (#F43F5E)
8. Laptop/notebook computer, front view, flat design, rose/red color (#F43F5E)
9. Laptop/notebook computer, front view, flat design, mint color (#2CD1A8)
10. Laptop/notebook computer, front view, flat design, amber/gold color (#FBBF24)
11. Laptop/notebook computer, front view, flat design, sky-blue color (#38BDF8)
12. [EMPTY - leave blank/transparent]
13. [EMPTY - leave blank/transparent]
14. [EMPTY - leave blank/transparent]
15. [EMPTY - leave blank/transparent]
16. [EMPTY - leave blank/transparent]

Style requirements:
- Flat design, minimalist, consistent visual weight across all icons
- Use ONLY the exact hex color specified per icon (no gradients, single flat fill + optional 1 darker shade for depth)
- Each icon same overall size, clearly distinct silhouette
- High contrast against transparent background
- Transparent background (PNG)
- Grid layout: 4 rows x 4 columns
- Recommended total size: 4096x4096 pixels (512x512 per icon)
- Icons 8-11 (laptop) must share IDENTICAL shape/silhouette, differing ONLY in color
generation.note: Utility icons (existing 6, see 'existing_icons' above) already generated — do not regenerate. This 'icons' list + 'generation' block covers only the 11 pending structural icons, generated in ONE 4x4 grid call via the extension popup.
